chunks: Have you not seen those who claim that they believe in what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you, while they desire to take rulings from al-Taghut, even though they were commanded to disbelieve in it? And Satan wishes to lead them astray with a far astray.

key_terms.الطَّاغُوت: Evil power or idol; that which exceeds bounds

ai.seo_question: Who are the hypocrites described in Surah An-Nisa who seek judgment from Taghut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Hypocrites of Medina who sought the judgment of idols like Al-Lat and Al-Uzza even after the Prophet's authority was established, illustrating the transition from tribal customs to divine law. It underscores the concept of 'Taghut' as any entity claiming authority over God, warning believers to reject all false sources of judgment in favor of the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt.
